package.description: Energy-aware code analysis and optimization CLI.

en-US.description: Energy-aware code analysis and optimization CLI.
en-US.longDescription:
isw is an energy-aware code analysis and optimization command-line tool. It
scans a project, detects hotspots, and can optimize code (optionally with an
LLM agent) to reduce estimated energy and performance cost. Distributed as a
single self-contained binary.
en-US.name: isw
